text: 🇲🇽🌎 "We have a very good relationship with China, and a very good relationship also with the government of the United States." "We decided to raise some of the tariffs on China in December of last year, but out of a decision of our own, of Plan México." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Plan Michoacán report, Nov 4, 2026 US Ambassador Ronald Johnson said China would be happy to see a chaotic US-Mexico border. China's embassy replied that Washington is trying to sow discord between Mexico and China. Asked about it, Sheinbaum said Mexico's main trade partnership is North America and it has no free trade agreement with China. She noted that US automakers in Mexico themselves import many parts from China. The only country Mexico has no relations with, she said, is Ecuador, "for having invaded Mexico's embassy." "We don't want this to be a debate in Mexico."

🔥🇲🇽 "What moral authority does Ugalde have to talk about democracy? None." "He was the articulator, the executor of the electoral fraud orchestrated by Vicente Fox himself and Calderón." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Plan Michoacán report, Nov 4, 2026 Former IFE president Luis Carlos Ugalde called for a review of all past electoral contracts and a "consensus" pick for the new INE head. Sheinbaum pointed to his own book, where he says he was named by the PRI on Elba Esther Gordillo's recommendation, and to Fox's admission days earlier that he made Calderón win in 2006. She added that Lorenzo Córdova, as INE president, did nothing about the two companies that have won the contracts for electoral materials for more than 20 years.

🇲🇽🏭 "In 28 years of exports, there has never been a case of screwworm in Michoacán." — Columba López, Secretary of Agriculture, Plan Michoacán report, Nov 4, 2026 After a price collapse disrupted the avocado harvest for three weeks, packers and workers reached a deal late Tuesday night, and exports resume. The Agriculture Secretary said viral screwworm videos were misrepresented: one load in Jalisco was headed to an oil plant, not export, and in Nayarit the larvae were in the boxes, not the fruit. Every orchard is registered, and 500 hectares are inspected at random each month. Sheinbaum said avocados from other countries now compete with Mexico's. Exporters will soon need a labor certificate showing workers are registered with IMSS, and a zero-deforestation certificate.

🇲🇽✊ "For us, education is the center. It is the link so that young people don't get close to criminal activity." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Plan Michoacán report, Nov 4, 2026 One year after the murder of Uruapan mayor Carlos Manzo, more than 20 federal officials reported on the social side of the Plan Michoacán for Peace and Justice: 118 billion pesos planned for 2025-2030 across 12 axes, 67% advanced. Every public school student in the state now has a scholarship. Electricity reaches 99.99% of homes. In Uruapan, INEGI's survey shows about 60% less victimization, though the perception of insecurity is slower to change. The security report comes next Tuesday.

text: 🇲🇽🌎 "Regardless of the result of the election, we always seek the best relationship with the United States, always guaranteeing respect for our sovereignty, territorial integrity and collaboration without subordination." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Plan Michoacán report, Nov 4, 2026 Asked about Tuesday's US midterm elections, Sheinbaum highlighted the wins of two people of Mexican origin: the governor-elect of California and the governor-elect of Texas, each with one or both parents born in Mexico. On whether the result could unlock the USMCA review, she said Mexico negotiates with the US federal government, not Congress, and it is "very early" to know if anything changes. "The conversations continue with the secretaries and with President Trump himself."
